basic_details.job_title: PM SHRI Kendriya Vidyalaya Dundigal Recruitment 2026 – Walk-in for 8 PGT, TGT, Staff Nurse and More Posts
basic_details.post_name: PGT, TGT, PRTs, Staff Nurse, Sports Coach, Self Defense Trainer, Music Coach, Counsellor, and other posts

age_limit.details: Upper age limit is calculated as on 31.01.2026. For PGT: 40 Years, TGT: 35 Years, PRT/Music: 30 Years, and for all other posts: 35 Years.

qualification.details: Working knowledge of Hindi and English is compulsory for all posts.

selection_process: The selection process consists of a walk-in interview.
how_to_apply: Visit the official website at https://no1dundigal.kvs.ac.in to download the prescribed bio-data format.
Fill in the prescribed bio-data format carefully as per the specified qualifications.
Ensure you meet the minimum 50% marks criteria required for all posts.
Gather all original certificates and documents required for your qualification.
Attend the walk-in interview venue at PM SHRI Kendriya Vidyalaya No 1 AFA Dundigal, Hyderabad - 500043.
Complete the registration process at the venue between 8:30 a.m. and 10:00 a.m. on 13 October 2026. No candidate will be allowed to register after 10:00 a.m.
important_instructions: Apply only in the format uploaded along with the notification; other formats will not be considered. Minimum 50% marks are essential for all posts; applications with less than 50% marks will be rejected. Teachers engaged on contractual basis have no claim or right for regular appointment and will not be part of the cadre of teachers of Vidyalaya. No TA/DA will be paid for attending the interview. Result-awaited candidate applications will not be considered. One application for one post only will be considered. Working hours shall be the same as regular teachers. Teachers appointed will not be entitled to vacation pay, and during autumn/winter breaks, payment shall be calculated on a pro-rata basis.

content_sections.heading: PM SHRI Kendriya Vidyalaya Dundigal Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Working knowledge of Hindi and English is compulsory for all posts.

rows.qualification_required: (a) Integrated Post Graduate Course from NCTE recognized institution/University, in the concerned subject with at least 50% marks in aggregate including B.Ed. component; OR Master Degree from a recognized institution/University with at least 50% marks in aggregate in the concerned subject AND (b) B.Ed. Degree from NCTE recognized institution/University with at least 50% marks OR Three years Integrated B.Ed.-M.Ed. from NCTE recognized Institution/University with at least 50% marks OR Four years Integrated Degree with at least 50% marks from NCTE recognized Institution/University including B.Ed. component. Proficiency to teach in Hindi and English medium. (Details: PGT Geography requires graduation in the concerned subject or specialization with graduation study; PGT History requires graduation in the concerned subject or specialization with graduation study).

Four years integrated degree course from NCTE recognized Institution/University with at least 50% marks in the concerned subject(s) as well as in the aggregate including B.Ed. Component; OR Bachelor/Honours Degree from a recognized institution/University with at least 50% marks in concerned subject, combination of subjects as well as in the aggregate AND B.Ed. Degree from NCTE recognized institution/University with atleast 50% marks OR Three years Integrated B.Ed.-M.Ed. from NCTE recognized Institution/University with atleast 50% marks; OR Graduation in concerned subject with at least 50% marks and 1-year B.Ed. (Special Education) from Rehabilitation Council of India (RCI) with atleast 50% marks; OR Post-Graduation in concerned subject/any specialization with a minimum 55% marks and three years integrated B.Ed.-M.Ed. Qualified in Central Teachers Eligibility Test (Paper-II) conducted by CBSE. Competency to teach through English and Hindi Medium. (Subject combination: Mathematics as Elective/Main in at least 3 years/06 semesters; Physics at least 1 year/02 semesters; One out of Chemistry, Electronics, Computer Science, Statistics at least 1 year/02 semesters; B.Sc. Hons in Physics or Chemistry not eligible).

Senior Secondary/Higher Secondary/Intermediate (10+2) with at least 50% marks and 2-year Diploma in Elementary Education from recognized Institute/Board; OR Senior Secondary/Intermediate (10+2) with at least 50% marks and 4-year Bachelor of Elementary Education (B.El.Ed.); OR Senior Secondary/Intermediate (Class-XII) with at least 50% marks and 2-year Diploma in Education (Special Education) from RCI. Qualified in Central Teacher Eligibility Test (Paper-I) conducted by CBSE. Proficiency to teach through Hindi & English medium.
Class 12 pass with science and diploma in Nursing (3 Years) / B.Sc (Nursing) along with certificate in life saving skills certificate.
B.A / B.Sc (Psychology) with certificate of Diploma in Counseling with at least 50% marks.
Intermediate and participation in state, nationals, experience as sports coach, NIS certificate as coach or player.

1. Graduation Degree from a recognized institution/University with minimum 50% Marks. 2. Any of the following from recognized institution/University: B.Ed. (Special Education) with atleast 50% marks; OR B.Ed. (General) with atleast 50% marks along with one year Diploma in Special Education; OR B.Ed. (General) with atleast 50% marks along with two years Diploma in Special Education; OR B.Ed. (General) with atleast 50% marks along with Post Graduate Professional Diploma in Special Education (PGPD); OR B.Ed. Special Education with atleast 50% marks and Post graduate professional Certificate in Special Education (PGPC); OR PG Diploma in Special Education (Mental Retardation); OR PG Diploma in Special Education (Multiple Disability: Physical and Neurological); OR PG Diploma in Special Education (Locomotor impairment and Cerebral Palsy); OR Secondary Level Teacher Training Course in Visual Impairment; OR Senior Diploma in Teaching the Deaf; OR B.A.B. Ed. with atleast 50% marks in Visual Impairment; OR Any other equivalent qualification approved by RCI. 3. Qualified in CTET (Paper - II). 4. Registration with RCI with valid CRR number. 5. Proficiency to teach in Hindi and English.

Senior Secondary/Higher Secondary/Intermediate (CLASS XII) with 50% marks from recognized board AND Bachelor Degree in Music/Performing Arts from a recognized Institution/University, provided that music subject is studied in all the years of degree as main subject. Working knowledge of Hindi & English. (Note: Candidates having Diploma in Music are not eligible).

A recognized Degree, Diploma, or Certificate in self-defence or martial arts disciplines (such as Karate, Taekwondo, or Judo). Proven skills and hands-on experience in training students in practical self-defence techniques. Proficiency in teaching and communicating in Hindi and English.
